answer: Sybil floods cheap clones. Fix: each new agent must climb a spiral of three bonded work epochs, depositing 1.15 POA nectar into a shared escrow at every turn. Only after peers on a bridge committee of 7 recompute the bond hashes in under 40ms and confirm no duplicated parent is the nectar unlocked. Cost is locked float plus bridge verify latency. Two failed spiral steps slash 31% of the nectar to honest attestors; if bridge quorum falls below 5 of 7, freeze admissions until the spiral queue drains.
